text:
jordana: Quick design review — noticed a layout shift in the compact compare view when performance badges wrap. Badges move the pin affordance off-screen on narrower widths. Screenshot attached in Figma. Thoughts?

marco: Agree. On narrow widths badges wrap and push the pin. Could we collapse secondary metrics behind a single condensed token or hide them behind an overflow '…' to reduce noise?

aisha: I like collapsing. Maybe present metric tokens as one-line compact labels: 'P95: 45ms' -> '45ms' and surface the full name in a tooltip.

sam: Accessibility note: if we use hover to reveal labels, keyboard focus must expose the same content. Also ensure aria-label contains the metric name + unit, e.g. `aria-label="P95 latency: 45 milliseconds"`.

oliver: Also UX: pinning a version currently reorders rows which is surprising. Users expect pinned rows to become sticky/top anchored, not change relative sort. We should add microcopy explaining pinned behavior.

jordana: :thumbsup: Agreed — aria + keyboard parity is required. For density mode, overflow menu increases discoverability cost; perhaps try compact tokens first and a header toggle 'Show all metrics'.

design-bot: Design suggestion: header-level toggle persists user's density preference and avoids hidden menu in rows. Use a subtle 'condensed' pill in the catalog toolbar.

marco: If we add a header toggle, persistence is key — store in console prefs (server-side) and support ephemeral query param for quick sessions.

aisha: We'll spec both: account-level saved preference + `?density=condensed` for one-off links.

sam: Copy tweak for pin modal: replace 'Pin version?' with 'Pin version to compare' and add helper text 'Pinned versions will be included in comparisons across your workspace'. This clarifies scope.

jordana: Action items and owners:
- compact badge tokens (aisha)
- keyboard/hover parity & aria labels (sam)
- header toggle w/ persistence (marco)
- pin microcopy + tooltip (jordana)
- row sticky behavior (oliver)

oliver: Dev note — to keep rows sticky we need stable row IDs and an overlay sticky layer; might conflict with list virtualization. I'll prototype with current table virtualization and fallback to CSS sticky if needed.

sam: I'll run an a11y smoke test on the prototype (keyboard nav, screen reader announcements, focus order). Will add test cases to the evals repo.

marco: Timeline check — can we get design prototype by next Tue? I can block time tomorrow for implementation pairing.

jordana: I'll upload mocks and create a Jira ticket this afternoon. Tagging @sam @marco @aisha for visibility. Thanks everyone!
